_comment: Predeclared before the runs that use it (third-round review, R5, R10, R12). Committed on its own; the evaluation reads it and does not change it. scripts/run_evaluation.py records its SHA-256 in results/evaluation.json.

seeds.note: Settings are selected on the tuning seeds only and then evaluated on the evaluation seeds, which the selection never sees.

matched_comparison.pipeline: common: every row runs ALL_FEATURES (risk engine, feedback, backoff, number intelligence, caps lifted); only the destination admission policy differs

policies.none: no destination policy (block tests off, no counter): the reference for attributable harm
policies.sequential: block tests, graded action; grid sprt_threshold x block_credit_thresholds
policies.counter_graded_daily: per-block counter of SMS sends, daily window, graded action (challenge past the limit, non-SMS past twice the limit)
policies.counter_graded_short: per-block counter of SMS sends, short window that refills, graded action
policies.counter_refuse_daily: per-block counter of SMS sends, daily window, refusing action

densities.200: 144 legitimate sends per block per day

matched_comparison.reduced_grid_at_other_densities: counters, the default sequential setting and none
matched_comparison.service_target: legitimate completion % on the tuning seeds >= completion % of the default sequential setting (threshold 1000, credit 1) at the same density minus 0.5 percentage points
matched_comparison.selection_rule: within each policy family and density, among settings meeting the service target, the one with the lowest mean leakage summed over the four pumpers on the tuning seeds; ties to the more permissive setting
matched_comparison.false_alarm_matching: at density 200, for each credit value, the lowest threshold whose mean verdict events per day at 65 % conversion on the tuning seeds do not exceed the default's; reported at matched false-alarm burden on the evaluation seeds
matched_comparison.reported: service (completion, refusal, challenge) at 65 % and 80 %, leakage per pumper, verdict incidence and exposure, descriptive hits, and completion attributable to the policy (paired per request against 'none' on the same seed); paired differences against the default with bootstrap intervals

robustness.design: Latin hypercube over the ranges below, generator seed 2026

held_out_family.note: Attack rates and pools outside the 10-60 requests/min and 500-50 000 address ranges every tuned default was developed on; legitimate traffic with block-level conversion heterogeneity, poor routes, resends and a demand burst, none of which the defaults were tuned against.

claims.C1: Signature attacks (datacenter rotation, premium-prefix pumping, single client) with adaptive caps: leaked <= 5 % of attack requests and legitimate completion >= the no-attack completion at the same point and seed minus 2 percentage points. Holds if true in >= 90 % of (point, seed, attacker) cells.
claims.C2: Residential farm (human-like CAPTCHA scores), caps lifted: leaked >= 90 % of attack requests. Holds if true in >= 90 % of cells.
claims.C3: Concentrated pumper whose carrier never verifies, caps lifted: contained (5 sustained quiet minutes) with leaked <= 30 % of attack requests. Holds if true in >= 90 % of cells.
claims.C4: Default sequential tests, 6 hours of legitimate traffic on 200 blocks: at points with conversion >= 0.75, verdict events <= 1 per 1000 legitimate requests. Holds if true in >= 90 % of those cells; points below 0.75 are reported, not judged.
claims.C5: Residential farm with caps: v2 (adaptive) leaks <= 0.7 x v1 (static) on the same point and seed, and refuses at least 10 percentage points more first-time users. Holds if both are true in >= 90 % of cells.
